question:

The fight of the cobra and the mongoose / is a classic drama often seen in India, / and the outcome was largely the same.

options.text: The fight of the cobra and the mongoose
is a classic drama often seen in India
and the outcome was largely the same

solution:
The erroneous part is:** and the outcome was largely the same**.
